Sandbox_ACS_ColdTemperature_tooltip: Air temperature below which food lying in the world spoils at the fridge rate (uses the vanilla Refrigeration Effectiveness setting). The temperature is the game's own for that spot: outdoor air outside, and the building's temperature indoors. Frozen food stays frozen until the air reaches this temperature. Default: 4.
Sandbox_ACS_FreezeTemperature_tooltip: Air temperature below which food lying in the world freezes. Frozen food does not spoil. Default: 0.
Sandbox_ACS_HoursToFreeze_tooltip: In-game hours for food to go from thawed to fully frozen in freezing air. Vanilla freezers take 4. Default: 4.
Sandbox_ACS_FreezersStopSpoilage_tooltip: Food in a powered freezer stops ageing entirely, even before it has fully frozen. Default: on.
Sandbox_ACS_FridgesStopSpoilage_tooltip: Same as above for powered fridges. When off, fridges use the vanilla Refrigeration Effectiveness rate. Default: off.
Sandbox_ACS_ScanRadius_tooltip: Food within this many tiles of the player is updated every 10 in-game minutes. Food further away is corrected as soon as you come back or its area loads. Default: 30.
